_comment_purpose: Source-of-truth template for the user-level Cursor MCP config. Installed by dev/ops/render-mcp.sh on Linux. Credentials are never stored here or in any vault CLI: Cursor resolves the env-colon placeholders from your shell environment when it launches each MCP server. Export TODIAGRAM_API_KEY, GITHUB_MCP_READ_TOKEN, and GITHUB_MCP_WRITE_TOKEN before starting Cursor. The 7 plugin-managed MCPs (supabase, vercel, figma, betterstack, context7, browser, app-control) live in the Cursor projects mcps folder and are auto-loaded by Cursor's plugin system; they are intentionally absent here.
_comment_rotation: Rotate a token at its provider, then update the exported environment variable and restart Cursor.
_comment_playwright_config: The Playwright MCP --config path uses Cursor's dollar-curly userHome and pathSeparator placeholders so the rendered config is portable across users and operating systems. Cursor's MCP loader expands these at MCP-server launch time.

mcpServers._comment_warning_github_write: WRITE ACCESS - github-write omits the X-MCP-Readonly header so this entry can mutate GitHub state. Only invoke when explicitly authorizing a write action (creating/editing issues, PRs, comments, releases, secrets, etc.). The PAT in GITHUB_MCP_WRITE_TOKEN should match what the AI Administrator orchestration in issue 644 expects: full repo + admin:repo_hook + workflow + secrets:write + admin:org if applicable.
mcpServers._comment_datadog: Datadog MCP intentionally disabled to reduce costs. To re-enable: restore the 'datadog' entry (see git history of this file), update the URL site (mcp.{site}.datadoghq.com), and read the API key from an exported environment variable with an env-colon placeholder.
mcpServers._comment_warning_gcloud_write: WRITE ACCESS via impersonation - gcloud-write reuses the viewer SA JSON for bootstrap auth and sets CLOUDSDK_AUTH_IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT to the editor SA email, so every gcloud command launched through this MCP automatically impersonates the editor SA without a static second key. Matches the AGENTS.md line 25 hybrid impersonation pattern. The viewer SA holds roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the editor SA (project-scoped to equipqr-prod) so impersonation works without keys. Only invoke when explicitly authorizing a write/admin action.

_comment_gcloud: gcloud entries read the viewer service-account JSON that dev/ops/render-mcp.sh installs from the file named by EQUIPQR_GCP_VIEWER_SA_JSON (skip with --skip-gcp).
